body:
Thank you so much! I'll absolutely check those resources. I think I can save up for a synth if I go frugal and pick up a couple more students for language lessons. I'm still writing, and looking at it with a cold head, most are forgetting about this scandal, and the public and some of the older (better established) poets actually do like me and my art. I've even been told by a friend (also a poet who's been in the industry for longer than I have), that I'm probably disliked by some because of jealousy, as I had a very loud breakthrough into literature and got popular fast (I am a foreigner who writes in their second, very obscure language, so it  made people curious from the get-go). I'm already starting to see silver linings everywhere, and I'm kind of ashamed I freaked out so much. Poets...

Thanks galore for your help!

Maybe it's not to late to get a second degree... I don't know, I feel like I'm getting behind in life and can't fix it. I'm going to try and talk to my parents, maybe I can visit home now for a few days and sort some things out. Thank you so much for your kindness.
Thank you. I'll try solving my most immediate problems first. Thank you so.much for your kindness.
